issue_request: FHIR-5714 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and requested making QuestionnaireAnswers.answered optional because not all systems know when answers were recorded or last updated and the element is not essential to interpreting the resource instance.
initial_application: The Jira comment says the change was pre-applied in SVN #4120. Imported Git commit f0dc36f74229ab41bbcf5a831b8730051dd9d923 is that revision and changed source/questionnaireanswers/questionnaireanswers-spreadsheet.xml so the authored date cardinality moved from 1..1 to 0..1.
additional_context: QuestionnaireAnswers was later renamed to QuestionnaireResponse by c51b8682420300c0f51dd0ad260d0be7f5ae20ab. The active current-build resource entry is questionnaireresponse=QuestionnaireResponse, and the current StructureDefinition has QuestionnaireResponse.authored with min 0 and max 1 plus a comment explaining the element is optional for systems that might not know the value. Bounded Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct FHIR-5714 discussion or conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because no source edit is needed; the authoritative current source already satisfies the applied issue.
